notes: Ukrainian ‘Magura’  washes up on beach outside Sevastopol. Russian forces destroy it but otherwise do not appear to react to new threat.
Road span collapsed, rail cars caught fire. Ukraine later acknowledged involvement. BBC assessed it likely a maritime drone.
Two Sea Baby USVs struck the bridge. One road span collapsed. Two civilians killed. SBU confirmed responsibility. Bridge reopened 14 Oct 2023.
Ship struck by naval drone at Novorossiysk naval base; listed heavily to port. First confirmed USV strike on a target in mainland Russia.
SBU claimed strike on the corvette Samum. Damage extent unconfirmed by Russia.
Propeller damage and a hole in the hull reported. RuMoD confirmed attack but did not comment on damage extent.
Sea Baby USV struck the Pavel Derzhavin. Damage confirmed; ship required repairs.
Russians had erected a barricade near the Crimean Bridge to stop USVs; Ukrainian drones destroyed it.
Both craft docked at Russian Navy base in Chornomorske were destroyed. Confirmed by HUR.
Russian demining, reconnaissance and hydrographic ship damaged by Sea Baby USV.
Sunk in Donuzlav Bay. HUR published video confirming the kill. Third notable Russian warship sunk in the war by Ukrainian forces.
Sunk off Alupka by HUR MO Group 13. Second notable Russian warship sunk in 2024.
Second strike on Sergey Kotov; ship sunk along with on-board helicopter. RuMoD confirmed attack.
Yamal suffered critical damage; hole in upper deck causing it to list to starboard. Azov also struck. Ukraine intelligence confirmed.
HUR confirmed destruction of two KC-701 Tuna type boats.
SBU reported Sea Baby USVs had laid 15+ naval mines off Crimea coast; four Russian warships were damaged after hitting them.
MAGURA V5 destroyed the Russian high-speed boat near Chornomorske.
MAGURA V5 adapted with R-73 air-to-air missile shot down a Russian Mi-8 near Cape Tarkhankut; a second was damaged.

First confirmed shootdown of jet aircraft by a maritime drone. HUR Magura V7s used AIM-9 Sidewinder missiles. Crew of first jet ejected and rescued; crew of second jet killed. Each Su-30 estimated at $50M.
Ukrainian USVs successfully struck a pair of oil tankers awaiting loading at Russia’s port of Novorossiysk on the Black Sea.
SBU detonated underwater explosives near bridge support pillars. Bridge closed several hours then reopened. Third USV/UUV attack on the bridge.
Sea Baby drones attacked two Russian shadow fleet tankers. MT Kairos struck ~28 nm west of Novorossiysk; MT Virat ~38 nm.
First claimed UUV attack on a submarine. SBU published video of explosion. UK MoD assessed it highly likely the B-271 Kolpino was seriously damaged and immobilised. Russia denied damage.
Ukrainian forces have damaged a Russian military icebreaker in the Baltic Sea port of Vyborg amid a mass overnight attack

Ukrainian Navy struck Russian patrol boats guarding the Kerch Bridge overnight on April 30. A Sobol patrol boat of the FSB Border Service and a Grachonok anti-sabotage boat were hit in the Kerch Strait area.

Ukrainian USV hit the Russian FSB patrol ship Izumrud near Novorossiysk. Newly released imagery from the Ukrainian navy shows the Russian ship resting against the port's quay wall, partially sunken, with a massive chunk missing amidships.
SBU Maritime Drones Struck RF "Shadow Fleet" Tankers "Louise 1" and "Banda" in the Black Sea
The SBU hit another Russian shadow-fleet tanker, Avero, in the Black Sea, and struck three oil depots in Russia’s Stavropol Krai.
